title: Catalog and Inventory Create & Edit lets the user create/edit items and make adjustments (cost/price shown only with See Financial Data)
preconds:
1. A user has a role with Parts Department ON and Catalog and Inventory Create & Edit ON.
  2. Test with See Financial Data both ON and OFF.
steps:
1. Create a new catalog/inventory item.
  2. Edit an existing item.
  3. Make an inventory adjustment.
  4. With See Financial Data ON, open the new-item form and look at the cost and price fields.
  5. With See Financial Data OFF, open the new-item form and look at the cost and price fields.
expected:
Creating, editing and adjusting all work.

With See Financial Data ON, the cost and price fields are shown and editable.

With See Financial Data OFF, the cost and price fields are hidden.
